record.question: Which among the following is the full form of OPEC?
options: Organisation of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
record.explanation: Answer A: Organisation of the Petroleum Exporting Countries. OPEC stands for Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries. Option A gives the correct phrase using the British spelling Organisation. Reference: https://guides.loc.gov/oil-and-gas-industry/organizations. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
